context: Mei and Aoi review a video they liked.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (置か/あい/おっしゃっ/不良/動画) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あの動画、すごく気に入ったの。
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最初のあいさつが、優しかったね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 先生が、丁寧におっしゃってたね。
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 音に、不良がなくて聞きやすかった。
lines.en: No audio defects, so it was easy to hear.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 机に、本がきれいに置かれてたね。
lines.en: Books were neatly placed on the desk.
lines.style: observant barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あいさつから、引き込まれたよね。
lines.en: We were drawn in from the greeting.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 不良が一つもなくて、さすがだね。
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 続きの動画も、見たいな。
lines.en: I want to see the next video too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
